data.title: 椎名真由理 · 缝纫室里的悄然陷落
data.description: 散落着碎布与玩偶的缝纫桌旁，吊带裙的肩带滑落到臂弯。真由理仰躺在布匹堆砌的软垫上，双手无措地抓紧对方的肩膀，在纯真与动情的夹缝中彻底绽放。
data.location: colorful craft room with sewing machine, spools of thread, and soft fabric rolls
data.action: reclining on a pile of plush velvet sewing cushions, pale blue sundress pulled down baring soft chest, arching back with joyful tearful moans
data.lighting: golden sunset beams filtering through lace window curtains illuminating velvet fabrics
data.mood: irresistible sweet passion, total romantic blossoming, breathtaking innocence lost to love
data.promptProse: Lying amidst colorful fabric rolls in the craft room, Mayuri sundress is pulled down, eyes wide with tears of profound ecstatic pleasure.
data.animaCaption: Mayuri lying among sewing cushions with parted dress, overwhelmed by sweet love.
